timeline.summary: Mirran survivors are welcomed into Zhalfir as refugees through the Omenpath Wrenn opened.
timeline.quote: The survivors of Mirrodin have been welcomed into the new plane as refugees

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Found and returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth encases Venser's head in stone to force him to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Koth flew into a rage and encased his head in a stone mask, coercing him to walk to Mirrodin.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Vengeance and Redemption". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth's planeswalker spark ignites as the tribes of his people fall into open war over corrupted ore.
timeline.quote: His planeswalker spark ignited when the tribes of his once peaceful people fell into open war for the first time in generations.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth purifies the ore, restoring the metal and slowing the tribal skirmishes.
timeline.quote: Koth believed he could use his ability to purify the ore, and with Koth's help, the solidity of the metal was restored and the skirmishes between tribes slowed.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth brands the Phyrexian insignia on his arm as a promise to save his people and begins planeswalking.
timeline.quote: he branded their insignia on his arm as a promise to his people to save them

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Gathering Forces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth fights Elspeth in the Urborg pits; she tries to kill him on seeing the Phyrexian mark until Ajani stops her.
timeline.quote: She was stopped by the timely intervention of Ajani Goldmane who had come looking for Elspeth.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Gathering Forces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth, enraged by Venser's carelessness, encases his head in a stone mask to force him to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Koth flew into a rage and encased his head in a stone mask, coercing him to walk to Mirrodin.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Gathering Forces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Corrupted Harvester captures Venser and Koth, and Elspeth returns to help them escape.
timeline.quote: Venser and Koth fell quickly to a Corrupted Harvester and were dragged back to its lair near Ish Sah .

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Scarred". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth Tirel returns and Koth, a Vulshok native to Mirrodin, is introduced as planeswalkers involved in the story.
timeline.quote: a new planeswalker by the name of Koth is introduced, a Vulshok native to Mirrodin

citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Oxidda Chain Venser disables a leveler, and in Koth's village Koth's compleated mother attacks them and they destroy her.
timeline.quote: she has become compleated and attempts to kill them

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth has a panic attack after a fight with nim and a Phyrexian zombie and leaves.
timeline.quote: Elspeth has a panic attack and leaves

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser reveals to Koth that he is actually seeking Karn.
timeline.quote: Venser had revealed to Koth that he is actually seeking Karn

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser and Koth are captured in the Mephidross and brought to the Phyrexian lair at Ish Sah.
timeline.quote: taken capture and brought into their lair at Ish Sah

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth escapes by melting his manacles and Elspeth kills the Phyrexians and frees Venser.
timeline.quote: Elspeth steps through, killing the Phyrexians and freeing Venser

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth confesses she was complicit with Phyrexians who tortured prisoners on her plane.
timeline.quote: she was complicit with the Phyrexians who tortured prisoners on her plane

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The trio reaches the Mirran resistance led by Ezuri.
timeline.quote: there encounter the Mirran resistance, led by the renegade elf, Ezuri

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret dispatches a crusher attacking the trio and leads them to the Surgical Bay.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret leads the others to the Surgical Bay

citation.work: Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn
citation.text: "Scars of Mirrodin: The Quest for Karn", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth and Elspeth find Venser in his workshop and he shows them his planeshifting ship built from Phyrexian parts.
timeline.quote: Venser showed his incomplete ship to the pair

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth recognizes the Phyrexian parts, threatens Venser, traps his head in a stone mask and forces him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: trapping his head in a stone mask and commanding him to planeswalk to Mirrodin

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group is ambushed by nim in the Mephidross, and Elspeth says she can go no further.
timeline.quote: the group was ambushed by nim

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser and Koth are captured by a Corrupted Harvester; Elspeth reappears and the trio escape and reach the Black Lacuna.
timeline.quote: Venser and Koth quickly fell to a Corrupted Harvester

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret captures Elspeth and Venser after Koth leaves with Melira.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret ordered a halt to the battle and captured the two Planeswalkers

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth and Melira free the pair; Tezzeret's forces fight Glissa's, letting the companions reach Karn's throne room.
timeline.quote: his forces did battle with Glissa's, allowing the companions to escape

citation.text: "Venser", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth restores the Vulshok's fragile peace.
timeline.quote: only the act of the new Vulshok leader, Koth could restore their fragile peace.

citation.text: "Vulshok", section "Tribes of the Vulshok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth emerges as a leader and offers to purify ore for the Anvil tribe, slowing the skirmishes.
timeline.quote: He approached the Anvil and offered his help.

citation.text: "The Human Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Nov 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth, Elspeth and Venser try to track the Phyrexian corruption to its source, but it is far too late.
timeline.quote: And all three of them believed they could track the Phyrexian corruption to its source

citation.work: Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered
citation.text: "Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Mirrans realize the full breadth of the threat and unite under a single banner.
timeline.quote: The struggle has caused Mirrodin's heterogeneous population to fly a single banner.

citation.work: Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered
citation.text: "Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth sends partisans into the Tangle to bring survivors to the tunnels below Kuldotha.
timeline.quote: Koth sent partisans into the Tangle to bring survivors to the safe haven of the tunnels below Kuldotha.

citation.text: Koth's Courier (Mirrodin Besieged, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth breaks into Ish Sah and frees her companions.
timeline.quote: she made her way to where they were held and cut a swath of destruction to them

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The companions fight Phyrexian butchers and escape through a meat shaft.
timeline.quote: Elspeth slew many, but they were outnumbered

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The companions meet the rebel leader Ezuri, who backs down when threatened.
timeline.quote: But when Elspeth threatened Ezuri, and Venser displayed a bit of his magic, the elf backed down and his followers fled.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn asks the group to lead the resistance with Melira.
timeline.quote: He asked them to begin organizing and leading the resistance with Melira to try to cleanse Mirrodin, no matter how long it would take.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "The Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth sinks Elspeth into the ground and shields her from the spellbomb blast so she can planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: He told her to go, but she did not budge, so he used his magic to sink her into the ground and create a shield against the blast, giving her only one option to escape.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Fall of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth is captured and forced to fight in Sheoldred's Coliseum, from which he escapes changed.
timeline.quote: He was sent to the Dross Pits and forced to fight in Sheoldred's Coliseum.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Fall of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, Koth and Venser free Melira from Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Melira was freed by Elspeth Tirel , Koth , and Venser from Tezzeret 's clutches

citation.text: "Melira", section "Quest for Karn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Vanishing sowed chaos among the Vulshok forge-tribes, until Koth and the war with Phyrexia reunited them.
timeline.quote: The Vanishing sowed chaos among the forge-tribes

citation.text: "Public Displays of Aggression". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The resistance is slaughtered and Koth sacrifices himself to let a wounded Elspeth escape.
timeline.quote: a Phyrexian Obliterator grievously injured the trapped knight before she could leave

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Mirrodin Falls". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth finds Karn imprisoned in the Seedcore but must leave him.
timeline.quote: In the Seedcore, they met Karn imprisoned.

citation.text: "Koth of the Hammer", section "Assault on New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth leads the Mirrans to form new nomadic groups.
timeline.quote: Under strong leadership from Koth, the Mirrans put aside their differences and formed new, nomadic groups.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia (plane)", section "Mirran holdouts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koth melts what was not darksteel.
timeline.quote: Looks like that wasn't darksteel after all.

citation.text: Smelt (Magic 2013, 2012), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Melira provides immunity to the Phyrexian contagion.
timeline.quote: a young Mirran named Melira provided us with a natural immunity to the Phyrexian contagion

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Koth infiltrate the praetors' cathedral-fortress.
timeline.quote: Koth and I managed to infiltrate their cathedral-fortress

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth's spellbomb, modified with Venser's schematics, is placed beneath the new throne room.
timeline.quote: We'd modified it using Venser's schematics.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians break at the sealed door; Koth sets the spellbomb.
timeline.quote: Koth set the spellbomb.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth tells Elspeth she is leaving and that there is nothing to come back for.
timeline.quote: Seal this world off, and throw away the key.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Koth encased Venser's head in rock and coerced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: He encased his head in rock and coerced him to planeswalk to Mirrodin.

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth sinks Elspeth to her knees in stone and raises a wall between them.
timeline.quote: he just sunk me up to my knees in the stone and left me there

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth's spellbomb explodes on the other side of the wall.
timeline.quote: Koth's spellbomb exploded on the other side of his makeshift wall

citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth recalls the purity of Mirrodin-that-was in darksteel.
timeline.quote: It reflects the purity of Mirrodin-that-was.

citation.text: Darksteel Ingot (Commander 2016, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elspeth calls the plan a death sentence and storms out.
timeline.quote: That's a death sentence,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is reunited with Koth, whom she thought dead.
timeline.quote: Koth, I thought you were dead!

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Melira demands honesty about what the sylex will do to Mirrodin, arguing her people have already survived the end of their plane.
timeline.quote: Your plane doesn't matter so much more than ours that I'm going to help you sacrifice what little we have left.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth explains the route down through the Hunter Maze and Surgical Bay to land in the Dross Pits above the Fair Basilica.
timeline.quote: We'll bypass both to land in the Dross Pits, directly above the Fair Basilica.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth describes the Mirrans' dire survival and resolve; Elspeth apologizes for leaving.
timeline.quote: As long as one of us is breathing, we'll keep fighting back.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth introduces hexgold, a Mirran metal that protects somewhat against phyresis, and offers it for the team's gear.
timeline.quote: Our gear has been treated with a substance we call hexgold.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth announces he will join the descent with a demolition team as a backup if the sylex fails.
timeline.quote: I have a demolition team standing by to do what needs to be done if your sylex fails.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
timeline.quote: made her own descent into the shadows of New Phyrexia

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The team lands in the Dross Pits, a rotting landscape of necrogen pools.
timeline.quote: Pools of glowing green liquid she recognized as necrogen dominated the landscape

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth explains the thanes of the Dross Pits, four of whom support Urabrask's rebellion, so the team can use the chaos for cover.
timeline.quote: Seven thanes rule the Dross Pits, but they've never been united.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace breaks free of Tyvar and strides off alone; the group abandons its safe route and follows him because he carries the sylex.
timeline.quote: He has the sylex. If we lose that, we lose everything.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth identifies Sheoldred's Coliseum and reveals that he once escaped it.
timeline.quote: No one exits the coliseum alive and unchanged. I escaped. Mostly.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth, Nahiri, Elspeth, Kaito and Tyvar fight the Phyrexians in the coliseum while Jace crosses unseen to Vraska.
timeline.quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Outside the coliseum, the group is cornered by massed Phyrexian ranks.
timeline.quote: They stepped straight into the middle of a war.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and the others regroup in the rubble, finding a hole in the sky and that Nahiri has vanished.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was nowhere to be seen.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya relents and hands Jace the sylex, and the group sets off toward Norn's altar.
timeline.quote: until finally, with a disgusted expression, she shoved it into his arms

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 3: Inconceivable Losses" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The survivors hurry across the Fair Basilica's bridges, mourning Nahiri's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: We have to keep moving to honor the ending she chose.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth explains Elesh Norn ossifies her favorites and adds them to her Fair Basilica as the group passes a colossus.
timeline.quote: Turned to bone and added to her Fair Basilica.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Melira discuss how the corrupted World Tree should have split the plane, and Melira says Karn is imprisoned beneath it.
timeline.quote: Norn's tree is planted below in the Seedcore, where she imprisoned Karn.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 4: Impossible Odds" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The team descends into the Mycosynth Gardens, where Melira warns them not to touch the mycosynth.
